description: Whether a library project's simulation prints what the project expects (the manifest's expect: the site's lab expectations). Sent at the start with nothing matched, then each time a pattern appears for the first time, and once with timedOut when the project's time (twice its seconds, four times with icount, plus five) passes first. A pattern seen after that is reported only when it completes the set. Not sent for projects without an expectation, the user's own projects, or debug sessions.

missing.description: Patterns not seen yet. Empty: the output is as expected.

needs.description: What the output needs beyond the board: none, wifi (the simulated network reaches nothing), or parts (the project's parts on the Circuit dock).

seconds.description: How long a board takes to print it all.
